import sys

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    h = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

    for i in range(n - 1):
        if h[i] + 2 <= h[i + 1]:
            diff = (h[i + 1] - h[i]) // 2
            h[i] += diff
            h[i + 1] -= diff

    print(' '.join(map(str, h)))

solve()
